moon.name: Shackleton Crater Rim (Artemis III Candidate)
moon.mission_relevance: Peaks of near-eternal sunlight adjacent to permanently shadowed water-ice cold traps; steep rugged highland rim.

moon.name: Marius Hills Skylight & Lava Tube
moon.mission_relevance: Subsurface basaltic lava tube skylight offering natural radiation shielding and stable thermal environment for permanent habitats.

moon.name: Aristarchus Pyroclastic Plateau
moon.mission_relevance: Largest lunar dark-mantle pyroclastic deposit; prime target for oxygen ISRU from iron/titanium-rich volcanic glass.

moon.name: de Gerlache Rim 2 (Artemis III Candidate)
moon.mission_relevance: Anorthositic impact-cratered ridge bordering deep cryogenic PSRs with high H-index signatures.

moon.name: Mare Tranquillitatis Pit Crater
moon.mission_relevance: Confirmed radar-imaged overhang and subsurface conduit in flat titanium-rich mare basalts.

moon.name: Schrödinger Impact Basin Floor & Pyroclastic Vent
moon.region: Lunar Far Side South Polar Region
moon.mission_relevance: Peak-ring impact basin combining anorthositic uplift, impact melt sheet, and a major pyroclastic cone.

mars.name: Jezero Crater Paleo-Delta & Rim
mars.mission_relevance: Ancient fluvio-lacustrine fan-delta rich in Fe/Mg smectite clays, olivine-carbonate units, and volcanic floor basalts.

mars.name: Arcadia Planitia Ice-Rich Plains
mars.mission_relevance: Prime human landing site candidate: flat low-elevation volcanic plains underlain by shallow SHARAD-detected water ice sheets.

mars.name: Elysium Planitia / Cerberus Fossae
mars.mission_relevance: Young Amazonian flood basalts and tectonic fissures with maximum solar availability for equatorial surface bases.

mars.name: Mawrth Vallis Phyllosilicate Sequence
mars.mission_relevance: Thick stratified sequences of Al/Fe/Mg clays and jarosite sulfates; high astrobiology and bound-water ISRU value.

mars.name: Arsia Mons Seven Sisters Lava Tube Pits
mars.mission_relevance: Deep volcanic collapse skylights on shield volcano flanks providing subsurface radiation shelter.

mars.name: Valles Marineris — Melas Chasma Sulfate Terrace
mars.mission_relevance: High-atmospheric-pressure canyon floor with polyhydrated sulfate mounds and steep basaltic walls.

earth.name: Haughton Impact Crater, Devon Island
earth.mission_relevance: 23 km impact structure in a polar desert with impact breccia, ground-ice permafrost, and extreme diurnal lighting cycles similar to Lunar South Pole & Martian craters.

earth.name: Atacama Desert — Yungay Hyper-Arid Core
earth.mission_relevance: Hyper-arid soils containing perchlorates, sulfates (gypsum/jarosite), and phyllosilicates matching Mawrth Vallis and Martian evaporite plains.

earth.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys — University Valley
earth.mission_relevance: Steep dolerite/anorthositic-analog valley rims above shallow ice-cemented permafrost; premier testbed for Lunar South Pole & Arcadia Planitia ice drills.

earth.name: Monte Corona Skylight & Lava Tube System
earth.analog_category: Planetary Skylight & Lava Tube Benchmark (ESA Pangaea)
earth.mission_relevance: 6 km basaltic lava tube with 30m-wide collapse skylights structurally analogous to Marius Hills Pit (Moon) and Arsia Mons Pits (Mars).

earth.name: Mauna Loa Basaltic Flank & Tephra Cones
earth.mission_relevance: Unweathered pahoehoe/aa tholeiitic basalts and glassy tephra closely matching lunar mare basalts and Martian Tharsis shield flanks.

earth.name: Askja & Holuhraun Glacio-Volcanic Highlands
earth.mission_relevance: Basaltic lava fields, pumice pyroclastics, and periglacial ice sheets used for Apollo astronaut geology training and Mars rover trials.

earth.name: Waw an Namus Dark Pyroclastic Caldera
earth.analog_category: Under-Studied Candidate — Lunar Pyroclastic Mantle Match
earth.mission_relevance: Hyper-arid caldera surrounded by a 20 km dark basaltic/olivine tephra apron; strong topographic & spectral analog for Aristarchus Plateau dark mantle deposits.

earth.name: Salar de Antofalla & Puna Volcanic Basin
earth.analog_category: Under-Studied Candidate — High-UV Canyon & Sulfate Match
earth.mission_relevance: High-altitude tectonic trough bounded by steep volcanic walls and sulfate-halite evaporite terraces; top match for Melas Chasma (Valles Marineris).

earth.name: Lake Salda Hydromagnesite Fan-Delta
earth.mission_relevance: Alluvial fan deltas eroding ultramafic/olivine bedrock and precipitating hydromagnesite carbonates, directly mirroring Jezero Crater's marginal carbonate unit.

earth.name: Gruber Mountains (Wohlthat Massif) Anorthosite Ridge
earth.analog_category: Under-Studied Candidate — Lunar South Pole Highland + Ice Match
earth.mission_relevance: Rare exposed Proterozoic massif-type anorthosite ridges protruding through polar ice sheets; exceptional mineralogical + topographic match for Shackleton & de Gerlache rims.

earth.name: Craters of the Moon — Great Rift Basalt Plains
earth.mission_relevance: Low-relief Holocene flood basalts, pit craters, and open rift fissures matching Mare Tranquillitatis and Elysium Planitia / Cerberus Fossae.

earth.name: Lonar Basaltic Impact Crater
earth.mission_relevance: One of the few terrestrial hypervelocity impact craters formed directly in flood basalts, producing maskelynite impact glass and basaltic ejecta breccia.

earth.name: Kaibab Plateau & San Francisco Volcanic Field (ICESat-2 ATL03 Track)
earth.region: Northern Arizona, USA (Apollo / Artemis Field Test Region)
earth.analog_category: Live ICESat-2 ATL03 Laser Altimetry Calibration Site
earth.mission_relevance: Directly sampled by our extracted ATLAS/ICESat-2 L2A (ATL03) granule G3510681565-NSIDC_CPRD; high-elevation plateau adjacent to Northern Arizona cinder cones and Meteor Crater.

earth.name: Mackenzie Delta / Tuktoyaktuk Ice-Rich Polygonal Plains
earth.analog_category: Under-Studied Candidate — Arcadia Planitia Subsurface Ice Match
earth.mission_relevance: Low-relief plains underlain by massive tabular ground ice and polygonal thermal-contraction features closely mirroring Arcadia Planitia on Mars.
